sector.physical_sector_ratio_requires: Two physical sectors with specified internal forms and an independent relative normalization.

tagged_model.readout: Uniform diagonal mean of the signed frozen-field charge over the two complete PR 334 boundary-clock windows, conditional on this path. Same marked flux and midpoint residence rule.
tagged_model.model: M_hat = g * mean(p), positive g, zero intercept after checking both vacua
tagged_model.new_local_controls: The half dose and the 3/8 profile are held out of the gain determination. M=1 and both endpoint profiles are published and serve as archival comparisons. This protocol is local and informed by knowledge of PR 334.
tagged_model.acceptance: Full analytic relative-error interval inside [-1/50,1/50] gives PASS, disjoint gives FAIL, overlap gives HOLD. Calibrate once. No second profile-specific gain. Raw current deduced from symmetrically shifted past clocks at fixed weights.
tagged_model.gain_interval_precision: Rational enclosure of Delta^2 = sqrt(3/722), using integer square root at 10^-40 absolute resolution.

charge_witness.path: Convex segment between the two published normalized-density centers at e=-1/4. Recalculate fine current; test zero and common positive charge at distinct markers; use strictly admissible densities. This is a pointwise obstruction, not a test of a distributional estimator.

physical_transfer.gate: Independent physical standard and matched charge, vacuum, calibrated physical readout and uncertainty are required. Exclude all held-out rows from fit; apply frozen g, same preparation prescription with mass varied, then admissible profile variation. Use inherited 2 percent mass criterion with full simultaneous uncertainty. Missing inputs imply NOT_RUN.
